import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int totalInputs = scanner.nextInt();
        int btcAvailable = scanner.nextInt();
        int[] btcDifferences = new int[100];
        int evenCount = 0, oddCount = 0;
        int storedRight = 0;
        for (int index = 0; index < totalInputs; index++) {
            int currentLeft = 0;
            if (storedRight == 0) {
                currentLeft = scanner.nextInt();
            } else {
                currentLeft = storedRight;
                storedRight = 0;
            }
            if (currentLeft % 2 == 0) {
                evenCount++;
            } else {
                oddCount++;
            }
            if (evenCount == oddCount && index != totalInputs - 1) {
                storedRight = scanner.nextInt();
                int difference = Math.abs(currentLeft - storedRight);
                btcDifferences[difference] += 1;
                evenCount = 0;
                oddCount = 0;
            }
        }
        int totalSawn = 0;
        int currentCostSum = 0;
        for (int diff = 0; diff < 100; diff++) {
            for (int count = 0; count < btcDifferences[diff]; count++) {
                currentCostSum += diff;
                if (currentCostSum <= btcAvailable) {
                    totalSawn++;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(totalSawn);
    }
}
